rule: Owner decision O100 (2026-10-28): every AA chart footnote on a ranked configuration is registered here by its exact text and classified once by an editor: 'pricing omission' (AA says its published cost omits a pricing term; O94), with the largest factor the note states for that term or null when it states none (O98: the row then competes over [C, infinity)), or 'not a pricing omission', with a reason. The build stops on any unregistered or changed footnote until it is classified.
